title: Every BIS international debt securities row for the world by kind of borrower, every quarter
source: Bank for International Settlements, international debt securities (WS_DEBT_SEC2_PUB 1.0)
note: All Countries excluding residents (3P) is the world total and regional groups repeat their countries, so adding every row counts money more than once. EU1 combines the ECU, the euro and the currencies it replaced.
